--- note
An HTML comment holding a registered tag name. A blank line inserted inside a comment ends it early, so everything the comment hid would come back as live content; the raw HTML regions of CommonMark's block grammar are masked before matching for exactly this reason. The comment is dropped whole, as it always was.
